narrative.overview: Large dark fields establish seriousness; bright paper sections support comprehension; emerald is reserved for direction, status, and brand emphasis. Precious-metals imagery supplies tangible evidence while generous spacing keeps the experience calm.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Emerald marks emphasis, active navigation, confirmation, and directional links; it does not fill every card or compete with content.

rules.name: The Reading-Order Rule
rules.body: Responsive layouts preserve headline, explanation, action, and proof in that order.

dos: Use physical precious-metals imagery as visual proof.
Vary dark, paper, and mist sections.
Keep legal and article columns narrow.
donts: Collect sensitive data without an approved backend.
